2607.19837.title: Know Your Agent: Reconnaissance-Driven Pentesting of AI Agents
2607.19837.paper_summary: Traditional pentesting uses reconnaissance at each step to uncover unseen weaknesses, build stronger attacks, and advance the objective; we argue that AI agents require the same treatment. We formalize agent reconnaissance by modeling the process and identifying the knowledge assets it seeks to extract: what they are, how they are used, and which agent weaknesses they exploit to give adversaries leverage in indirect prompt injection attacks. We instantiate these insights in Know Your Agent (KYA), a framework that automates black-box, reconnaissance-driven pentesting by probing agents, building target profiles, and using those profiles to craft stronger attacks. We evaluate KYA on agent-security benchmarks and a real-world coding agent, and release KYA, its benchmarks, and baseline implementations for reproducibility.
2607.19837.paper_summary_zh: 傳統的滲透測試在每一步都使用偵查來揭示未被察覺的弱點，構建更強的攻擊，並推進目標；我們認為人工智慧代理也需要相同的處理。我們通過建模該過程並識別其尋求提取的知識資產來正式化代理偵查：它們是什麼，如何使用，以及它們利用哪些代理弱點來給對手在間接提示注入攻擊中提供優勢。我們在「了解你的代理」（Know Your Agent, KYA）中實現這些見解，這是一個通過探測代理、構建目標檔案並利用這些檔案來製作更強攻擊的自動化黑箱、以偵查為驅動的滲透測試框架。我們在代理安全基準和一個真實的編碼代理上評估KYA，並釋放KYA、其基準和基線實現以便於重現。
